---
title: FITS reduction learning path
description: Read, calibrate, combine, and inspect images using the established astroimred API.
---

Start with a single FITS image. Add calibration and combination once the
image's units, header, and mask are understood.

## Choose your next task

| Task | Guide | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read an image and inspect its metadata | [FITS quickstart](../quickstart.qmd) | A `CCDData` image and a header summary |
| Apply supplied calibration frames | [Bias, dark, and flat correction](calibrate-images.qmd) | A calibrated image with a checkable pixel value |
| Combine calibrated exposures | [Image combination](combine-images.qmd) | One image from a stack of exposures |
| Work from a terminal | [Command-line tools](command-line.qmd) | Copied, combined, or arithmetically transformed FITS files |
| Measure a source | [Aperture photometry](aperture-photometry.qmd) | Background-subtracted flux and instrumental magnitude |
| Inspect coma structure | [Comet enhancement](comet-enhancement.qmd) | Five enhancements of a packaged FITS image |

The Python tutorials use small synthetic inputs or the packaged CometCIEF
sample. The command-line guide uses
placeholder FITS paths that you replace with your own files. No tutorial needs
a telescope archive or a network service.

## Use the reference for individual operations

The existing documentation groups the package into FITS management, image
operations, preprocessing, and cosmic-ray rejection. The website keeps those
topics and generates their reference pages from the current source docstrings.

| Existing topic | Website reference |
| --- | --- |
| FITS files and headers | [Read images](../api/fitsmgmt.io.load_ccd.qmd) and [build summaries](../api/fitsmgmt.table.fits_summary.qmd) |
| Image operations | [Copy sections](../api/imutil.imcopy.imcopy.qmd) and [image arithmetic](../api/imutil.imarith.imarith.qmd) |
| Preprocessing | [Calibration pipeline](../api/reduction.preproc.ccdred.qmd) |
| Cosmic-ray rejection | [Cosmic-ray removal](../api/reduction.crrej.crrej.qmd) and [bad-pixel detection](../api/reduction.crrej.medfilt_bpm.qmd) |

For instrument data, select calibration masters, masks, rejection parameters,
and uncertainty treatment explicitly. The examples demonstrate API behavior;
they do not choose an observing program's calibration policy.
